deferredRolloutObligations.required: Reviewed legacy-channel bridge; published tag/Release ID, trusted revision, commit/tree/tag-object and previous/bridge/successor identities; archive digests and producer/run/attempt/job/artifact evidence; actual Windows and native Unix old updater -> delivered bridge -> new-format pin clean-client receipts bound to delivered bytes.

Reviewed target/setup and real repository/producer/controller identities; workflow revision, sealed request/source SHA/nonce, actual release-mode run/attempt, all six Python3.11/3.12 Windows/Linux/macOS jobs, Ruff, aggregate and native/profile results; non-integration-branch merged/squashed final-SHA proof. Ordinary PR CI is not deferred.

Complete generic and GPID Step13 trials, including protected settings/App role denials, hostile-source/approval/signing probes, exact tag/assets/latest identities, concurrency and lost-response/second-machine recovery, expiry/journal restore, branch advancement, dev composition and post-hook/resume; exact executed argv, exits, authorizations and remote records.

At least ten sequential warm-dependency starts; exclude only confirmation wait; min/median/p95 and all failures; p95<=120 seconds; environment/history size; separate queue/review/approval/build/publication/recovery intervals and comparable legacy workload where available. No missing baseline or speedup claim is passed.
